-- Module:Skilltree/data
-- The skill trees: the combat skills (skill IDs, 4 to a row, in the order of the in-game window), the 3 Abyssal
-- combat skills, the passives (tile number = the skill level of the tree they need) and the Abyssal passive.
-- In a passive text a {word} is shown in orange. Add the other trees here in the same way.
return {
	Sorcery = {
		combat = { 10752, 10667, 10153, 10670,
		           10151, 11939, 11314, 12796,
		           11967, 14774, 10664, 23593 },
		abyssal = { 34093, 34281, 34291 },
		-- the rank shown in the title of the skill, its versions (ancestral skills) included (from the game; only these are shown)
		ranks = { [10752] = 1, [10667] = 18, [10153] = 5, [10670] = 11, [10151] = 8, [11939] = 7, [11314] = 1, [12796] = 3,
		          [11967] = 4, [14774] = 3, [10664] = 2, [23593] = 1, [34093] = 2, [34281] = 1, [34291] = 1,
		          [36474] = 1, [36475] = 1, [36478] = 2, [36479] = 2, [36476] = 4, [36477] = 4 },
		-- the numbers of the skills at their rank (from the game): mana, range (m) or caster = true, eff = effect range (m),
		-- ma = Magic Attack %, flat = the flat part of the damage, cast and cd in seconds (cast time without the cast time
		-- reduction of a character; Arc Lightning 3.1 is worked out from the 2.5 the game showed at -20.5%), charges = Abyssal Charges,
		-- desc = the text of the skill when the game's differs from the API (numbers of the rank; the damage stays a placeholder)
		cards = {
			[10752] = { mana = 16, range = 20, ma = 209, cast = 1,
				desc = "Deals #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} Magic Damage to an enemy.\nCan be used up to |cFFFF9C273 times|r in a row without triggering a cooldown.\nAttack 1: Inflicts Burning for |cFFFF9C273.2sec|r.\nAttack 3: Converts |cFFFF9C2720%|r of damage dealt to Enervated enemies to mana; inflicts Conflagration on Burning enemies.\nAll 3 attacks deal |cFFFF9C27+12%|r additional damage to targets under freezing effects.\n|cff00ff45Hold down for continuous use.|r" },
			[10667] = { mana = 349, range = 20, ma = 372, flat = 991, cast = 2, cd = 6 },
			[10153] = { mana = 208, caster = true, cd = 45 },
			[10670] = { mana = 1169, range = 20, ma = 624, flat = 898, cast = 3.1, cd = 20,
				desc = "Fires lightning bolts to deal #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} Magic Damage and Shock an enemy.\nDeals |cFFFF9C27568|r Magic Damage over |cFFFF9C278sec|r to Shocked enemies; also Shocks all other enemies within |cFFFF9C272m|r. When this skill levels up, it increases damage, but also cast time." },
			[10151] = { mana = 946, caster = true, eff = 8, ma = 238, flat = 633, cd = 36, bdur = { ['Ice Shard'] = 6.2 },
				desc = "Deals #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} damage to all enemies within |cFFFF9C278 meters|r with a chance to Snare for |cFFFF9C276.2sec|r.\nSnare duration reduced |cFFFF9C27-50%|r in PvP." },
			[11939] = { mana = 1183, caster = true, eff = 10, ma = 260, flat = 259, cast = 2, cd = 39 },
			[11314] = { mana = 184, caster = true, cast = 2, cd = 45 },
			[12796] = { mana = 355, caster = true, cd = 21 },
			[11967] = { mana = 749, range = 20, ma = 280, flat = 576, cd = 36 },
			[14774] = { mana = 394, caster = true, ma = 150, flat = 576, cd = 33 },
			[10664] = { mana = 1814, range = 25, eff = 4, ma = 900, flat = 1728, cast = 5, cd = 45 },
			[23593] = { mana = 268, range = 22, eff = 6, ma = 120, flat = 201, cd = 30 },
			-- the ancestral versions (36474 Flamebolt Flame, 36478 / 36479 Meteor Strike Wave / Lightning, 36476 / 36477
			-- Chain Lightning Flame / Wave): no cast time reduction applies to these in the game, the cast time is the API's
			[36474] = { mana = 16, range = 20, ma = 313, cast = 1.5 },
			[36478] = { mana = 1814, range = 25, eff = 10, ma = 500, flat = 288, cast = 5, cd = 45 },
			[36479] = { mana = 1814, range = 25, eff = 4, ma = 540, flat = 1728, cd = 45 },
			[36476] = { mana = 749, range = 20, ma = 280, flat = 576, cd = 36 },
			[36477] = { mana = 749, range = 20, ma = 280, flat = 576, cd = 36 },
			[34093] = { charges = '1', caster = true,
				desc = "Teleport to a random location |cFFFF9C275m-15m|r away.\nNo cooldown. Spend Abyssal Charges to cast repeatedly.\nCan't be used while Snared." },
			[34281] = { charges = '2 ~ 4', caster = true, cd = 120 },
			[34291] = { charges = '4 ~ 6', range = 20, ma = 1080, flat = 3744, cast = 6, cd = 22 },
		},
		passives = {
			{ num = 2, name = 'Mana Pool Increase', icon = 'icon_skill_magic03.png',
			  text = 'Increases max mana {+20%}.' },
			{ num = 4, name = 'Magic Range Boost', icon = 'icon_skill_magic18.png',
			  text = 'Increases the range for Sorcery skills {+5m}.' },
			{ num = 6, name = 'Efficient Sorcery', icon = 'icon_skill_magic21.png',
			  text = 'Decreases the mana cost for Sorcery skills {-20%}.' },
			{ num = 7, name = 'Mana Flurry', icon = 'icon_skill_magic31.png',
			  text = 'Decreases Cast Time for all skills {-6%}.\nGrants {Mana Fountain} each time Flamebolt\'s third attack, Frigid Tracks, or Magic Circle is used.\nMana Fountain:\n- Increases Attack Speed {+20}\n- Decreases Cast Time {-2%}\n- Decreases Sorcery skill cooldowns {-2%}\n- Decreases Physical Defense {-3%}\n- Stacks up to {8} times' },
			{ num = 8, name = 'Recuperation', icon = 'icon_skill_magic32.png',
			  text = 'Decreases the duration of Sleep and Fear {-10%}.' },
			{ num = 9, name = 'Magic Precision', icon = 'icon_skill_magic20.png',
			  text = 'Increases Magic Critical Rate {+10%}.' },
			{ num = 10, name = "Aranzeb's Infusion", icon = 'icon_skill_magic25.png',
			  text = 'Increases Sorcery skill damage {+15%}.' },
		},
		abyssalPassive = { name = 'Wrathful Casting', icon = 'icon_skill_hatred26.png',
			text = "Freezing Arrow, Arc Lightning, Searing Rain, Chain Lightning, and Meteor Strike each grant {1} Abyssal Charge whenever they're used.",
			note = 'Cannot be upgraded further.' },
	},
}
